name: 請求管理の各ページを切り替えるセクションタブ
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied Slack billing section-tab strip as a Japanese-localized image at exactly 1220x64 px, 19.06:1. Keep it as a very shallow single horizontal row on white. No page title, sidebar, toolbar, browser chrome, or extra controls.

Show exactly six tabs from left to right: 「概要」, 「履歴」, 「設定」, 「連絡先」, 「メンバー変更」, and 「支払い方法」. The last tab, 「支払い方法」, is selected. Position the labels near the source x anchors: 22, 214, 382, 557, 742, and 1012 px. Use compact 16 px Japanese system sans text centered vertically at y≈32. Inactive labels are Slack blue and medium weight; the active label is dark charcoal and semibold.

Preserve the white background and thin pale-gray horizontal rule along the bottom. The selected tab has a subtle light-gray outline on its top and sides, beginning around x=989 and ending at the right crop edge, with its bottom edge aligned to the divider. Keep the tab spacing, height, and text baselines close to the reference. No icons, badges, underlines, filled active background, or other text. All six labels must remain one line and fully legible inside the 1220x64 crop.
reviewNotes: 日本語6タブの生成候補。選択枠とタブラベルが右へ徐々にずれ、支払い方法タブの枠左端も原図より右に寄る。第2版で位置修正が必要。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
